references.text: Introduces the daughters of Zelophehad and notes that he had no sons, only daughters - the background to their claim to inheritance rights
God's response to the daughters' claim - they are right, and they shall receive their father's inheritance
Further handling of the inheritance issue for Zelophehad's daughters, focusing on preserving the inheritance within the tribe
Fulfillment of the promise - Zelophehad's daughters receive their inheritance in the land of Canaan among their fathers' brothers
The names of the five daughters who made the claim to inheritance after their father
Zelophehad's daughters marry within their tribe to preserve the inheritance, as commanded
